summary: The bearer's next wound dealt with a wielded melee weapon is Wounds Kill; not expended if the target does not actually receive the wound.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Only a wound dealt by the bearer with a wielded melee weapon. Used up only when a target actually receives the wound.

termination.note: Expended by the next wound the bearer deals with a wielded melee weapon that the target actually receives.

properties.note: If the target does not actually receive a wound (e.g. because of a Resistance), Poison is not expended.

references.name: resistant
references.note: A Resistance is the example of a wound not actually received.

clarifications.text: If the target does not actually receive the wound (for example it is stopped by a Resistance), Poison is not expended and stays on.
